def extract_layout(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    hr=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=0]
    vc=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=0]
    rstarts=[0]+[x+1 for x in hr]; rends=hr+[h]
    cstarts=[0]+[x+1 for x in vc]; cends=vc+[w]
    cells=[]
    for r0,r1 in zip(rstarts,rends):
      row=[]
      for c0,c1 in zip(cstarts,cends):
        row.append([line[c0:c1] for line in grid[r0:r1]])
      cells.append(row)
    return cells, list(zip(rstarts,rends)), list(zip(cstarts,cends)), hr,vc

def reflect(p, vertical=False, horizontal=False):
    q=[row[::-1] if horizontal else row[:] for row in p]
    if vertical: q=q[::-1]
    return q

def panel_data(p):
    colors={v for row in p for v in row if v}
    if len(colors)!=1: return None,None
    return next(iter(colors)),p

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    cells,rs,cs,hr,vc=extract_layout(grid)
    R,C=len(cells),len(cells[0])
    additions={}
    # Complete 2x2 groups whose three present patterns are axis reflections of one base.
    for r in range(R-1):
      for c in range(C-1):
        entries=[cells[r+i][c+j] for i,j in [(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)]]
        infos=[panel_data(p) for p in entries]
        present=[(k,infos[k]) for k in range(4) if infos[k][0] is not None]
        if len(present)!=3 or len({x[1][0] for x in present})!=1: continue
        canon=[]
        for k,(color,p) in present:
            rr,cc=divmod(k,2)
            canon.append(reflect(p,vertical=bool(rr),horizontal=bool(cc)))
        if all(x==canon[0] for x in canon[1:]):
            missing=next(k for k in range(4) if infos[k][0] is None)
            rr,cc=divmod(missing,2)
            additions[(r+rr,c+cc)]=(present[0][1][0],reflect(canon[0],vertical=bool(rr),horizontal=bool(cc)))
    # Also complete a repeated side copy when its diagonal counterpart is the 180-degree image.
    # This handles the displaced diagonal pair shown in the first demonstration.
    for r in range(R):
      for c in range(C):
        if panel_data(cells[r][c])[0] is not None or (r,c) in additions: continue
        candidates=[]
        for dr,dc in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]:
          ar,ac=r+dr,c+dc
          if not(0<=ar<R and 0<=ac<C): continue
          color,p=panel_data(cells[ar][ac])
          if color is None: continue
          for sr,sc in [(-dr,dc),(dr,-dc)]:
            # diagonally across the target, mirrored across the side direction
            br,bc=r+sr,c+sc
            if not(0<=br<R and 0<=bc<C): continue
            col2,q=panel_data(cells[br][bc])
            if col2==color and q==reflect(p,vertical=True,horizontal=True):
              candidates.append((color,p))
        if candidates and all(x==candidates[0] for x in candidates): additions[(r,c)]=candidates[0]
    for (r,c),(color,p) in additions.items():
        r0,r1=rs[r]; c0,c1=cs[c]
        for i in range(min(r1-r0,len(p))):
          for j in range(min(c1-c0,len(p[i]))):
            if p[i][j]: out[r0+i][c0+j]=p[i][j]
    return out
